name: Da Lat Railway Station
kicker: Art-deco station with DALAT on the facade
summary: Walk through the 1930s art-deco station, with its peaked roofs and DALAT across the yellow facade, then take the short tourist train to Trai Mat and Linh Phuoc if you want the ride. Allow 30 to 60 minutes without the train.
getThere: A walk or taxi from Xuan Huong Lake
heroCaption: The DALAT facade and the peaked roofs

notice.title: The line is a tourist train only
notice.body: The ride toward Trai Mat and Linh Phuoc is a short tourist run. There is no passenger train to Ho Chi Minh City.

body: The yellow facade carries DALAT under the peaked roofs. This is the 1930s art-deco station. Without the train, 30 to 60 minutes is enough to see the hall and the platform.
The ride that leaves here is the short tourist train toward Trai Mat and the mosaic pagoda at Linh Phuoc. Come in the morning, before the tour buses.

figures.caption: A tourist train car at the station
figures.alt: A wooden tourist train car beside Da Lat Railway Station

gettingThere: The station is in town, a walk or short taxi ride from Xuan Huong Lake.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Walk or taxi; it is an in-town stop.

admissionNote: Station entry: Check on arrival. 50,000 VND from 1 October 2024 on desk tables, including Bao Van Hoa; no fee on the provincial page. Train fare: Check on arrival.
